meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: Phi model as the main brain, ONNX on his PC
meta.note: Phi = central nervous system. Procedural machinery = body. Nathan's law honored: physics recurses free, weights think centrally.

architecture.brain: One Phi model (Phi-3-mini or Phi-4-mini, ONNX, quantized) serves Mira + the Brain (Sentinel/Watchdog/Mira/MATER collective reasoning).
architecture.runtime: onnxruntime-web in-page, WebGPU execution provider, WASM fallback. Model downloads on first awaken from HuggingFace (~2GB), cached in browser.
scope: Mira's chat reasoning (genuine replies, not templates)
Brain deliberations (maintainer debates with real reasoning)
Organelle mutation decisions (adaptive instances guided by reasoning)
Gate triage (Mira ranks the queue with understanding)
not_in_scope: Per-agent LLMs — the 23 agents stay procedural (cost + physics-beats-weights law)
Phone — PC only (WebGPU + model size); phone runs fully procedural

laws: Explicit awaken: a control to download/awaken the brain with progress — never a silent 2GB download (respects 'UI never opens on its own' + user consent)
Graceful fallback: no WebGPU or declined download -> full procedural mode, everything still works
The tick stays procedural; Phi engages for high-level cognition only
PROPOSAL_ONLY unchanged: Phi reasons, Mira's Gate still approves
honest_costs: 10-30 tok/sec on decent PC GPU — deliberations take seconds, not ms
VRAM/RAM pressure: the 3D scene + Phi share the GPU
queue: Dedicated star-system pass after organelles/back-out land.

webgpu_node.what: A dedicated compute node living in Ember's interior (the innermost doll), housing the Phi brain. It runs onnxruntime-web with the WebGPU execution provider (navigator.gpu; Chrome/Edge on his PC), WASM fallback when WebGPU is absent.
does: Eligible for compute-shader work later (WebGPU compute pipelines, not just rendering)
webgpu_node.visual: The node appears in Ember's interior as the brain's physical seat — distinct from the organelle cells; its activity (inference load) reads visually.
honest_limits: WebGPU required for full speed; WASM fallback is ~5-10x slower
PC only — phones lack the VRAM and the model budget
First load downloads the model; the node shows download/progress state
